authorityBasis: Project-owner direction to prepare the governed Build 6 production candidate without making the private repository public, with a fresh readback showing that the production-signing environment still has no required-reviewer rule.

planConstraintEvidence.requiredReviewerConfigurationAttemptResu: not-repeated; prior governed Build 5 attempt returned HTTP 422
planConstraintEvidence.interpretation: The live private-repository environment still exposes no required-reviewer rule; this is a new single-build exception, not reuse of the expired Build 5 exception.

failClosedConditions: The exception is invalid for any build other than build 6.
The exception is invalid if the dispatch approval reference differs from BAF-REF-003-C5.
The exception is invalid if the workflow actor or triggering actor is not the authorized dispatcher.
The exception is invalid if the repository is not private.
The exception is invalid if the live environment name or required secret-name inventory differs.
The exception is invalid if a required-reviewer rule is configured; the governed policy must then return to reviewer-enforced mode.
Any GitHub plan-eligibility change requires source re-adjudication before a later production-candidate build.
The exception does not authorize distribution, deployment, promotion or unrestricted plant release.
expiresWhen: Build 6 is represented by a verified remote built tag or the governed repository/environment state differs, whichever occurs first.
